options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: End Goal
options.doc:
The end goal required to beat the game.

All Masks: Defeat Razorbeard in the Crow's Nest after gathering 4 masks.
Treasure%: Take Jano's offer in the Cave of Bad Dreams.
100%: Requires collecting all 1000 lums, 80 cages, and 4 masks, then defeating Razorbeard.
Any%: Defeat Razorbeard in the Crow's Nest by any means.
All Cages: Defeat Razorbeard in the Crow's Nest after gathering 4 masks and 80 cages.
options.doc_fr:
Le but final requis pour battre le match.

All Masks: Vaincre la barbe à razor dans le nid du Crow après avoir recueilli 4 masques.
Treasure%: Prenez l'offre de Jano dans la grotte des mauvais rêves.
100% : Nécessite la collecte des 1000 lums, 80 cages et 4 masques, puis la défaite de la barbe à rasoir.
Any%: Défeat Razorbeard in the Crow's Nest par tous les moyens.
All Cages: Vaincre la barbe à razor dans le nid de Crow's après avoir recueilli 4 masques et 80 cages.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Death Link Amnesty
options.doc: The amount of deaths required to send a single death link.
options.doc_fr: Le nombre de décès requis pour envoyer un seul lien de décès.

options.name: Damage Link
options.doc: Whether death links should trigger every time Rayman takes damage instead of only when he respawns.

options.name: Room Randomisation
options.doc: Whether to enable room randomization which will randomize the order of all levels.

options.name: Randomisation Seed
options.doc: A seed to use for room randomisation. If left blank the randomisation will be random. Can be used to use the same randomised layout in multiple games.
options.doc_fr: Une graine à utiliser pour la randomisation des locaux. Si elle est laissée en blanc, la randomisation sera aléatoire. Peut être utilisé pour utiliser la même disposition randomisée dans plusieurs jeux.

options.name: Restrictive Room Randomisation Positions
options.doc: Restricts where rooms can be placed so all rooms have to match the same entrance-exit combination as the one they replace. This looks better visually but results in worse randomization of some levels.
options.doc_fr: Restrictions où les chambres peuvent être placées de sorte que toutes les chambres doivent correspondre à la même combinaison entrée-sortie que celle qu'elles remplacent. Cela semble mieux visuellement, mais se traduit par une randomisation pire de certains niveaux.

options.name: Lum Bundle Size
options.doc: If lumsanity is enabled, decides how many lums should be bundled together into a single check.
options.doc_fr: Si la lumsanité est activée, décide combien de lums doivent être regroupés en un seul contrôle.

options.name: Lumsanity
options.doc: Whether all individual yellow lums should be their own checks instead of only super lums. This will add 710 extra progression checks!

options.name: Fragmented Silver Lums
options.doc: Whether Silver Lums should be fragmented into 22 individual checks instead of 2. This changes every individual sub-level with swings into a separate check to be able to use the swings in that level.

options.name: Instant Portal Access
options.doc: Whether all portals should be accessible as soon as you obtain enough lums. Will speed up the game considerably, cannot be combined with 'Add Unlock Level Checks'.

options.name: Add Unlock Level Checks
options.doc: Whether to create checks for unlocking each individual portal. Will slow down the game, cannot be combined with 'Instant Portal Access'.

options.name: Fixed Level Lengths
options.doc: Whether to use fixed level lengths with room randomisation, which ensures every level has as many rooms as it does in the base game.

options.name: Improved Portal Teleporting
options.doc: Whether portals in the Hall of Doors should allow you to teleport to individual rooms directly. Makes it easier to revisit levels and get missed checks.

options.name: Randomize Hover
options.doc: Whether the ability for Rayman to hover should be randomized and require a check to use.

options.name: Randomize Ledge Grab
options.doc: Whether the ability for Rayman to grab ledges should be randomized and require a check to use.

options.name: Randomize Swim
options.doc: Whether the ability for Rayman to swim should be randomized and require a check to use. Rayman will be killed for touching water without receiving Swim, if this causes a softlock by e.g. entering Whale Bay 3, run `stuck` in the in-game console.

options.name: Randomize Lava Hover
options.doc: Whether the ability for Rayman to hover above lava in Beneath the Sanctuary of Rock and Lava should be randomized and require a check to use.

options.name: Include Ly Skip
options.doc: Includes checks behind Ly skip in The Fairy Glade 4 within logic before getting a Silver Lum.
options.doc_fr: Inclut les chèques derrière Ly skip dans The Fairy Glade 4 dans la logique avant d'obtenir un Silver Lum.

options.name: Include Backwards Slide Jumps
options.doc: Includes checks behind backwards slide jumps in The Sanctuary of Water and Ice within logic before getting a Silver Lum.
options.doc_fr: Inclut les contrôles derrière les sauts à glissière dans le Sanctuaire de l'eau et de la glace dans la logique avant d'obtenir un Silver Lum.

options.name: Include Early Echoing Caves Skip
options.doc: Includes the Early Echoing Caves skip as a valid way to reach other levels.
options.doc_fr: Comprend les grottes d'écho précoce sauter comme une façon valide d'atteindre d'autres niveaux.

options.name: Include Reverse EEC
options.doc: Includes the lum boost from The Fairy Glade Revisit area to get back to the main area as a valid way to reach other levels.
options.doc_fr: Comprend le boost lum de The Fairy Glade Revisite pour revenir à la zone principale comme une façon valable d'atteindre d'autres niveaux.

options.name: Include Kapoueh Skip
options.doc: Includes checks behind Kapoueh skip within logic before getting a Silver Lum.
options.doc_fr: Comprend les vérifications derrière Kapoueh skip dans la logique avant d'obtenir un Silver Lum.

options.name: Include Damage Boosts
options.doc: Includes checks behind damage boosts within logic before getting a Silver Lum, such as in The Bayou 1.
options.doc_fr: Comprend les contrôles derrière les dommages boosts dans la logique avant d'obtenir un Silver Lum, comme dans le Bayou 1.

options.name: Include Plum Wall Climb
options.doc: Includes checks obtainable in The Sanctuary of Stone and Fire 1 by climbing the wall with a plum within logic.
options.doc_fr: Comprend les vérifications obtenues dans le Sanctuaire de la pierre et du feu 1 en grimpant le mur avec une prune dans la logique.

options.name: Include Airswims
options.doc: Includes checks behind airswims within logic before getting a Silver Lum, such as exiting The Whale Bay 1.
options.doc_fr: Comprend les vérifications derrière les nageurs d'air dans la logique avant d'obtenir un Silver Lum, comme sortir de la baie de Whale 1.

options.name: Include Tornado Skip
options.doc: Includes checks behind completing The Fairy Glade 5 within logic before getting a Silver Lum, which requires using Tornado skip without needing the purple lum.
options.doc_fr: Inclut les contrôles derrière l'achèvement de la Fée Glade 5 dans la logique avant d'obtenir une Lum d'argent, qui nécessite l'utilisation de Tornado skip sans avoir besoin de la lum violet.

options.name: Include COBD Skip
options.doc: Includes checks behind obtaining the Elixir of Life within logic, which requires using COBD skip. Includes the cage after talking to Clark in The Menhir Hills 2.
options.doc_fr: Comprend les vérifications derrière l'obtention de l'Elixir de la vie dans la logique, qui nécessite l'utilisation de COBD skip. Comprend la cage après avoir parlé à Clark dans The Menhir Hills 2.

options.name: Include Technical Tricks
options.doc: Includes checks behind technical tricks (GLM/NaN) within logic before getting a Silver Lum, this includes any trick that can be easily executed by following precise technical steps. This includes The Sanctuary of Stone and Fire 1 GLM including backwards completion of that level and The Sanctuary of Stone and Fire 2 NaN Plum. It also includes the precise jump to complete Whale Bay 1 at the end.
options.doc_fr: Inclut les contrôles derrière les tricks techniques (GLM/NaN) dans la logique avant d'obtenir un Silver Lum, cela inclut tout trick qui peut être facilement exécuté en suivant des étapes techniques précises. Cela comprend le Sanctuaire de la pierre et du feu 1 GLM y compris l'achèvement en arrière de ce niveau et le Sanctuaire de la pierre et du feu 2 NaN Plum. Il comprend également le saut précis pour compléter Whale Bay 1 à la fin.

options.name: Include Jano Tricks
options.doc: Includes checks behind using the various Jano Skips before getting a Silver Lum, this includes the Super Lum in the boss fight area.
options.doc_fr: Comprend les contrôles derrière l'utilisation des différents Jano Skips avant d'obtenir un Silver Lum, cela inclut le Super Lum dans la zone de combat patron.
